_comment: This file is managed by the todo CLI. Do not edit it directly, by hand or with a script. Read it with todo: `todo next --json` (what to work on), `todo show --id <id|ref> --json` (one task), `todo list --flat` (every item as flat JSON records). Change it with todo commands (add, edit, move, status, assign, rm, ...; see `todo --help`), which keep its ids and rules valid.

sprints.name: AFK batch 2026-11-21
sprints.goal: Backlog items implemented overnight on next-steps

tasks.title: Reshape weather widget edit dialog to fit the screen
tasks.description: The Widget Settings dialog for the weather widget is too tall and too narrow: it scrolls vertically with Save/Cancel cut off at the bottom. Make it wider and lay settings out in columns/sections (e.g. location + display | extra info checkboxes in a grid | forecast + graph options) so it fits a typical screen without scrolling.

tasks.title: Refactor widget documentation page (/admin/docs/widgets)
tasks.description: Index page groups widgets by category as cards; each widget gets its own doc page with Overview (live preview + settings toggles) and Details (per-parameter reference) tabs.

subtasks.title: Index page: one section per widget category
subtasks.description: Category title uses the heading level that best fits the page hierarchy (h2/h3...); inside each category a 3-column grid of cards, each showing a simplified widget representation with its name below

subtasks.title: Dedicated page per widget
subtasks.description: Short description of the widget at the top, then a tab view with two tabs: Overview and Details

subtasks.title: Overview tab: live preview + settings
subtasks.description: Left side: rendered widget representation; right side: the widget's settings toggles, changes reflected live in the preview

subtasks.title: Details tab: parameter reference
subtasks.description: Specific description of each widget parameter

tasks.title: PNG preview for image dashboards in /admin/dashboards
tasks.description: The dashboards list has no way to see the rendered image of an image dashboard; even the existing Preview action does not show the image representation. Add a new column/icon, shown only for image dashboards, that opens a PNG preview.

subtasks.title: Preview-as-PNG column/icon in the dashboards list
Thin Vue render-preview view with rendering parameters
subtasks.description: Lets the user pick the e-ink display type, choose between plain PNG render and e-ink simulation, and pick from common e-ink panel sizes/resolutions

tasks.title: Improve the Add Widget dialog
tasks.description: Dashboard editor's Add Widget dialog: currently a narrow plain list of widgets with a close button

subtasks.title: Filter input at the top to narrow the widget list
Show a preview of the clicked widget
subtasks.description: Same approach as the live preview in the widget docs pages (/admin/docs/widgets)

subtasks.title: Insert / Cancel buttons
subtasks.description: Clicking a widget selects it (and shows the preview); Insert adds it, Cancel closes without adding

tasks.title: Drag and drop widgets into and out of a Stack widget
tasks.description: Bug: in the dashboard editor, widgets can't be dragged into or out of a Stack widget. Dragging an existing widget (e.g. Market) over a Stack doesn't drop it into the stack (the grid only shows the 12-column row placement), and a stack's children can't be dragged back out onto the row. Today children can only be added via the stack's own '+ Add' button.

tasks.title: Widget header bar: delete and duplicate buttons
tasks.description: In the dashboard editor, each widget card's top bar currently only has the edit (pencil) button. Put the widget controls there.

subtasks.title: Move the delete control into the widget's top bar
Duplicate widget feature + button in the top bar
subtasks.description: Copies the widget with its config and inserts it next to the original

tasks.title: Preview button in the dashboard edit view
tasks.description: Edit view header, left of Settings, chosen by dashboard type like the dashboards list (AdminDashboards.vue). Image dashboards: keep the existing 'E-ink preview' button (DashboardEditView.vue, already there). Interactive dashboards: add the missing button, an eye icon that opens the live viewer (dashboardViewUrl) in a new tab, as the list does.

tasks.title: Max Width: preset options plus manual input
tasks.description: Dashboard settings > Container > Max Width is a plain text field today. Offer sensible presets (e.g. 100%, 1600px, and a few common widths) in an editable dropdown, while still allowing a custom value to be typed.

tasks.title: Container alignment: replace dropdowns with a visual picker
tasks.description: Dashboard settings > Container: replace the Vertical Align and Horizontal Align dropdowns with an image-based picker, i.e. selectable options shown as icons/diagrams of the alignment (e.g. a 3x3 position grid covering both axes) instead of text lists.

tasks.title: Icon picker trigger doesn't look like a button
tasks.description: In widget config forms (e.g. Bookmark > Icon), the icon select trigger is just the icon glyph next to its name (ti-bookmark), with no affordance. Make it clearly clickable: bordered/outlined button or input-like field with the icon, its name and a 'choose' hint.

tasks.title: review new userauth capabilites for auth, e.g. PAT
Implement the Search widget
tasks.description: Search widget doesn't work. Backend renderer (internal/widgets/search/module.go) only emits an empty placeholder div, so the server-rendered viewer shows nothing; only an editor-side Vue component exists (webui/src/widgets/search). Implement real rendering: a search input that submits to the configured search engine in interactive dashboards; decide what image dashboards show.

tasks.title: Dashboard setting: show an Edit button on the rendered dashboard
tasks.description: New per-dashboard setting (off by default). When on, the rendered dashboard in the viewer shows an Edit button that opens this dashboard in the editor (/dashboards/<id>/edit), so entries can be changed from where you are looking at it. Needs: the setting in the dashboard model and settings view, the button in the viewer render (interactive dashboards only; not drawn on image/PNG output), and an editor URL that works when the viewer and editor are on different origins (HA add-on: viewer on host port, editor via ingress).

tasks.title: background editor
tasks.description: a background is a self contained unit
